docs: Logos content: the heading and an ordered list of three to eight logos, each a picture and the name it stands for. One object is valid in every logos layout.

logos.docs: the logos, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.docs: address of the logo; none: the placeholder

title.docs: the name of the company (the alt text of the logo)
